Ga Sài Gòn trực thuộc đơn vị nhà nước nê.en: Saigon was in the state unit, so it was in administrative hours, specifically from 7:30 – 1700. However, unlike other state units, Saigon had to work both Saturdays and Sundays to meet the people's needs, because two weekends were two days of the largest passenger population.
Ga Sài Gòn trực thuộc đơn vị nhà nước nê.zh: 西贡当时在州单位,所以是在行政上的时间,具体从7:30到15:00. 然而,与其他州分队不同的是,西贡必须同时在星期六和星期天工作,以满足人民的需要,因为两个周末是最大的客运量的两天.
